description: This Java file defines the main activity class for an Android app that manages device administration privileges and data wiping. It handles enabling/disabling admin rights, UI refreshing, and initiating device wipe with a confirmation dialog.

classes.name: MyMain
classes.description: Main activity for managing device admin and wiping data, includes UI controls for enabling/disabling device admin and performing wipe.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the layout.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from enabling device admin and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: refreshUi
methods.description: Updates the UI elements based on whether device admin is enabled.

methods.name: onAddAsAdmin
methods.description: Handles click to enable or disable device admin.

methods.name: enableAdmin
methods.description: Starts the intent to request device admin privileges.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Static method to restart the activity.

methods.name: onWipeData
methods.description: Shows a confirmation dialog before wiping device data.
